cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 careful compliment reverses B choice and A5 solo kitchen removes labor-sharing; S02 is confined mostly to a prefixed authority claim.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 china fear causes A3 careful plate assignment; B4 wrapping split causes A5 boxes left with B while A leaves.

relationship.evidence: B2 expresses a real preference and B4 proposes a workable compromise; A praises both while erasing them.

heightening.evidence: A5 calls leaving B all the plate work a privilege of private workspace.

specificity.evidence: A1 moving/books/plates establishes practical task choice.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 added charge phrase is redundant and harms the gracious voice.

coach2.situation: A1 moving/books/plates establishes practical task choice.
coach2.stated: A5 leaves boxes beside B; no promise of shared boxing is actually fulfilled.
coach2.inferred: A uses warmth to steadily narrow B choices.
coach2.missing: No hidden willingness to pack plates should be invented.
coach2.firstDefect: A3 cooperation-dependent accommodation is missing beyond praise.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 selects books from A1 offered alternatives.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 praises B4 idea but removes A contribution by leaving with books.
